sources.label: Grove cBEAM approved targets and execution record — September 3–18, 2026

phases.name: Phase 1
requirements: Exercise both enabled swap directions.
Create the initial liquidity position and then add liquidity to the existing position.
Complete a bounded partial liquidity removal and a complete exit, then restore the required exposure.
Keep every Uniswap v3 operation within ticks -10 and 10 and below 10 bps slippage.
Verify that deposits and swaps consume their respective rate limits by realised amounts; liquidity removals do not replenish deposit capacity or reduce unlimited withdrawal limits.
Maintain 1 million USD of pool exposure until the next spell, with an absolute minimum of 10 days.
Treat updateIntegrations, setMaxSlippage, setTWAPSecondsAgo, key validation, and expected-revert scenarios as pre-flight or simulation evidence.

operation_plan.expected: Mint USDS to the Grove proxy and consume the mint/burn rate limit.
Receive USDC and consume the USDC PSM swap rate limit.

operation_plan.action: Uniswap V3 USDC to AUSD swap
operation_plan.expected: Receive AUSD within minAmountOut and consume the USDC swap limit.

operation_plan.action: Uniswap V3 AUSD to USDC swap
operation_plan.expected: Receive USDC and leave approximately 500K AUSD for the liquidity position.
Mint a new tokenId over ticks -10 to 10 and consume aggregate and token deposit limits.
Return assets while keeping the position open; leave deposit capacity and unlimited withdrawal limits unchanged.
Finish the bounded roundtrip with zero position liquidity; leave deposit capacity and unlimited withdrawal limits unchanged.
Increase the existing tokenId and establish the minimum exposure for Phase 2.

phases.name: Phase 2
requirements: Supply the required exposure as soon as possible and maintain it until the next spell.
If 5 million USD was already allocated in Phase 1, maintain that allocation for four weeks; allocating above 4 million does not shorten the duration requirement.

phases.name: Phase 4
requirements: Final UniswapV3Facet phase; its facet-specific rate-limit targets are the standing parameters defined by this plan. Further increases are outside this ramp-up and require a new Prime proposal and risk review.
The source states that the CRR equals the current CRR minimum, noted as 2% in the document.

phases.name: Phase 1
requirements: Complete the Prime's approved AaveFacet Lindy KPI plan under Core Council supervision.
The plan must identify material capital-moving operations and branches, exposure-building operations, transaction amounts, expected onchain evidence, and pre-flight-only checks.
Use normal production permissions for live Lindy actions; configuration-only and expected-revert checks may be evidenced through deployment checks, tests, forks, or simulations.
Dewiz and Sidestream review technical completeness; BA Labs verifies consistency with phase parameters and tracks completion onchain.

Maintain continuous exposure of at least 1 million USD through execution of the next spell, targeting 14 days with a 10-day absolute floor. The existing four-week Phase 1 duration requirement is retained pending review.

phases.name: Phase 2
requirements: Establish at least 4 million USD of exposure promptly and maintain it continuously through execution of the next spell, targeting 14 days with a 10-day absolute floor.

phases.name: Phase 3
requirements: Establish at least 10 million USD of exposure promptly and maintain it continuously through execution of the next spell, targeting 14 days with a 10-day absolute floor.

phases.name: Phase 4
requirements: Establish at least 50 million USD of exposure promptly and maintain it continuously through execution of the next spell, targeting 14 days with a 10-day absolute floor.

phases.name: Phase 5
requirements: The source marks this phase as cancelled for Osero, with continuation reserved for a future Prime; the listed parameters remain planning values rather than evidence of activation.
This is the terminal AaveFacet stage in the plan, with no minimum exposure requirement and the listed AaveFacet limits designated as its standing planned limits.
Any later increase falls outside this ramp-up and requires a separate Prime proposal and risk review.
